Container.Name: plant-journal
Container.Overview: Private household plant journal. Log in to GHCR before installation. WUD reports newer stable versions but cannot automatically update this container.

Config.Name: Journal data
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite journal; include this directory in periodic Unraid appdata backups.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: LAN and tailnet access; do not forward this port on the public router.

Config.Name: WUD watch
Config.Description: Stable releases only; set false for a prerelease trial.

Config.Name: WUD stable tags
Config.Description: Exclude prerelease and mutable latest tags.

Config.Name: WUD trigger exclusion
Config.Description: Leave WUD's Docker updater enabled for other containers, but never automatically replace this one.
